title: Makoto Furukawa Writes, Sings Ending for One-Punch Man Season 3's 2nd Part
content: The official website for the anime of ONE and Yūsuke Murata 's One-Punch Man manga announced details on the ending theme song for the second cours (quarter of a year) of the third anime season on Saturday.

title: 'Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru' Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme
content: The official website of the Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ( Everyone's Darling Has a Secret ) television anime revealed additional cast and the ending theme on Saturday. The anime series adapting Kashiko Amane 's romantic comedy manga will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Additional Cast for 'Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Chinkururi and Nanashina 's Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu: Saikyou no Bishoujo Gundan wo Tsukuriagero ( Gacha Girls Corps ) light novel revealed a pair of additional cast and key visual (pictured) on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bless TV Anime's 1st Full Promo Video Announces January 8 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga presented the first full promotional video and a key visual on Saturday. The video announces that the anime will premiere on January 8. It also previews the ending theme song "New Page" by HIKKA .
author: ANN

title: 'There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her' Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Suisei 's Yūsha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Itanode, Kokuhaku Shite Mita ( There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her ) light novel series and Kairi 's manga adaptation announced on Saturday that production on a second season has been green-lit.
author: ANN
